description: An internal sealed class DistributedGrainDirectory implementing Orleans grain directory functionality, managing grain registrations, lookups, recovery, and view updates in a distributed cluster environment.

classes.name: DistributedGrainDirectory
classes.description: Manages distributed grain directory operations such as lookup, registration, recovery, and view updates within Orleans cluster.

classes.name: DistributedGrainDirectory.ITestHooks
classes.description: Interface providing test hooks for accessing primary silo for a grain and local records.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up the address of a specified grain ID asynchronously.

methods.name: Register (overload)
methods.description: Registers a grain address with a previous address asynchronously.

methods.name: RecoverRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Recovers registered activations for a given membership version and range asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Retrieves all registered activations for a given membership version and range asynchronously.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Refreshes the cluster membership view asynchronously.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in lifecycle events for the silo, managing startup and shutdown behaviors.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Continuously processes membership updates and manages partition ownerships.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Returns the primary silo address responsible for a given grain ID.

methods.name: GetLocalRecord
methods.description: Retrieves local grain address record if available.
